sentences.text: This large predator measured about 6 meters in length and weighed roughly 700 kilograms.
It was a bipedal dinosaur that moved using powerful hindlimbs.
Its forelimbs were short but extremely strong.
A large head carried long, curved teeth designed for hunting.
The genus Megalosaurus was formally established by William Buckland in 1824.
The type species, Megalosaurus bucklandii, was named by Gideon Mantell in 1827.
Fragments of this animal were actually described as early as the 17th century.
In 1939, bones from the Chipping Norton Limestone Formation were linked to the genus.
Buckland originally thought this creature was a quadruped and an amphibian that swam and walked on land.
He also argued that Megalosaurus helped ecosystems by killing old or sick animals to prevent suffering.
However, the discovery of Compsognathus in 1859 challenged the view that all meat-eating dinosaurs walked on four legs.
Today, M. bucklandii is the only valid species, as others are not directly related.
Richard Owen created the group Dinosauria in 1842, placing Megalosaurus within it.
A name announced by James Parkinson in 1822 is generally considered a nomen nudum.
Megalosaurus lived approximately 166 million years ago during the Middle Jurassic, specifically the Bathonian age.
Its habitat was located in what is now southern England.
It is debated whether the label "Scrotum humanum" was assigned by Richard Brookes or was an illustrator's error, though the ICZN ruled it invalid because it appeared only as an illustration label.
Scientists also debate whether a specific femur fragment can be definitively assigned to Megalosaurus rather than a different contemporary theropod.
